josiascouper: Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper reported to S-F15 with his brother's pocket watch sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
The report confirmed that the Concord held Verdel Ridge. Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
peter_moodster__moodie: After 2 days of war, S-F19 had a place for everything. On Day 3, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Leopold Moodie.
